summary.text: Patricia Fahy is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 46 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Fahy served in the State Assembly from 2013 to 2025 and has been a state senator since 2025; she is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Patricia Fahy earned a B.S. in political science from Northern Illinois University and an M.P.A. from the University of Illinois at Chicago.
Fahy represented Assembly District 109 from 2013 to 2025, succeeding Robert Reilly (D), and took office in the State Senate in 2025, succeeding Neil Breslin (D).

In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Disabilities Committee and is also assigned to the Agriculture, Cities 2, Environmental Conservation, Higher Education, Local Government, and Racing, Gaming and Wagering committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Fahy faces Martha McHugh (R / Conservative Party).
